annotations.text: Launch — configure the run: brief, optional GitHub repo (gortex-indexed), team template, Free vs Frontier models, and Solo vs two competing teams.
Arena — the centerpiece. 24 agents across two rival teams, each a role on a live model in its own sandbox. Flip the Free/Frontier tweak above the artboard to swap the model tier.
Verdict — both teams ship a working build; a judge scores them on the brief, code health, and whether it runs. Keep the winner or fork both.
